messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration for 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area consists of the four corners, the four edge midpoints, the four points at rational positions (1/4, 1/4), (3/4, 1/4), (1/4, 3/4), (3/4, 3/4), and the center point (1/2, 1/2), achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/16. This configuration is optimal because it uniformly distributes points across all symmetric subregions of the square while ensuring that any three points span at least one complete grid cell of the 4×4 subdivision, and no configuration of 13 points can avoid producing a triangle with area at most 1/16 by a pigeonhole argument on the partition of the unit square into 16 equal cells."}
